semanticCoverage.documentaryScope: Sourced past seven-day Dogecoin price record; not Dogecoin origin history.

subtitles.timingSource: Fresh Scribe word timestamps from the exact source MP4 audio stream

scenes.voiceText: В недельном ряду покажем измеренный восходящий фрагмент по реальным точкам, не продолжая линию в будущее.
scenes.dominantVisual: Seven sourced price samples with the measured rising section highlighted
scenes.composition: Full-frame market trace; low-contrast context segments; selected measured rise in green; start and snapshot anchors; no projected extension.
scenes.animation: Seven real points draw sequentially; camera pushes into the highlighted rise and settles at the last observed point.

scenes.voiceText: В том же ряду есть нисходящий участок.
scenes.dominantVisual: Sourced downward price path from the observed local peak to trough
scenes.composition: Large diagonal price path spans the frame; peak and trough are separated by a measured red descent, not a card.
scenes.animation: The observed drawdown segments reveal from peak to trough with a brief endpoint impact and downward camera follow.

scenes.dominantVisual: A documentary record of the sourced past seven-day market interval
scenes.composition: Warm archival paper field with a dominant measured timeline, seven sample markers, and a source/date stamp. This documents past price movement, not DOGE's origin.
scenes.animation: Paper layers settle in; sample markers appear in sequence; a restrained camera push ends on the snapshot marker.

scenes.dominantVisual: A measured chart line stopping at a clear past-data boundary
scenes.composition: A short, edge-to-edge red/white boundary interrupts the historical line; no BUY/SELL indicator and no oversized wording.
scenes.animation: A 1–2 second camera punch and brief impact flash stop the line at the boundary, then hand off to the statistic scene.

scenes.voiceText: Рыночная капитализация оценивает весь обращающийся рынок, а не цену одной монеты и не деньги на счёте.
scenes.dominantVisual: The sourced market-cap value held as the central full-frame visual
scenes.composition: The value fills the central field while thin circulating-market rings and a small source/time label clarify that this is market capitalization, not a coin price.
scenes.animation: The sourced value holds clearly while a fine gold accent line draws beneath it and the camera eases closer.

scenes.voiceText: Сравним монету с биткоином за одинаковые семь дней. Один временной интервал даёт контекст, но не объясняет причины.
scenes.dominantVisual: DOGE and BTC marks with sourced, matched-period seven-day returns
scenes.composition: Two large full-height fields meet at a narrow center axis. DOGE and BTC enter on opposite sides; proportional return bars share one 7D baseline.
scenes.animation: DOGE enters first, BTC follows, the shared time axis draws across both sides, then a restrained center push holds the comparison.

scenes.voiceText: Мемы и заголовки создают информационный шум. Эта сцена — абстрактная реконструкция, а не настоящая новость.
scenes.dominantVisual: Abstract, clearly reconstructed media fragments without fabricated headlines
scenes.composition: A warm editorial spread fills the canvas with layered paper, cropped columns, and signal bars. It contains no outlet names, fake article copy, dates, or quotations.
scenes.animation: Paper strips slide in on alternating masks, briefly overlap, then collapse into the community network.

scenes.voiceText: У монеты есть сообщество и проекты. Не будем подменять их выдуманными числами аудитории, постами или цитатами.
scenes.dominantVisual: A large DOGE mark surrounded by a growing field of generic connected nodes
scenes.composition: The network spans edge-to-edge around a central DOGE mark; nodes are anonymous and carry no invented counts, identities, posts, or quotes.
scenes.animation: Connections draw outward, generic nodes illuminate in waves, and the camera eases back to show network scale.
